name: 274. Injected tools, fallbacks and stream state keep what the client is owed (core-preservation) [SERIAL]
description: TXE-5540 regression. Local fixture regression: run with providerErrorFixture=1 against the gateway of tests/e2e/api/provider_config/provider-error-fixture.config.json, with tests/e2e/api/runners/provider-error-fixture.mjs as the only upstream and as the real MCP server behind the injected web_search: the rows read back the bytes that reached it from /__wire and the tools/call count from /__hits. A client's custom tool call is held in a turn that is re-asked and handed over from the turn that ends the loop, an upstream's other choice keeps its index, an attempt that ran an injected tool is neither retried nor followed by a fallback while one that ran none still falls back, chat n=2 serves both choices with no injected tools and keeps its stream refusal and unary contract with them, text after a tool call reaches the client once in stream order, and a caller tool named like the gateway search stays the caller's. Reconnect admission, trace deferral, pooled state and schema copies have no wire shape and are pinned in Go.

item.name: [held] responses client custom call beside an injected call - core-preservation

exec: if (pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixture') !== '1') {
pm.execution.skipRequest();
pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl') + '/__reset', method: 'POST' }, function (err, res) {
pm.test('core-preservation setup: the fixture was reset', function () {
pm.expect(err, String(err)).to.equal(null);
pm.expect(res.code).to.equal(200);
var FX = pm.variables.get('providerErrorFixtureUrl');
// state: the requests that reached the fixture, bytes as they arrived, and the MCP tool calls it answered.

function state(cb) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__wire', method: 'GET' }, function (e1, w) { pm.sendRequest({ url: FX + '/__hits', method: 'GET' }, function (e2, h) { pm.test('the fixture answered', function () { pm.expect(e1, String(e1)).to.equal(null); pm.expect(e2, String(e2)).to.equal(null); }); cb(w.json().data[0].calls.map(function (c) { return { path: c.path, body: JSON.parse(c.body) }; }), h.json().data[0].hits.__mcp_tool_calls || 0); }); }); }
function sse() { return pm.response.text().split('\n').filter(function (l) { return l.indexOf('data: ') === 0 && l !== 'data: [DONE]'; }).map(function (l) { return JSON.parse(l.slice(6)); }); }
function types(items) { return (items || []).map(function (i) { return i.type; }); }
pm.test('the client gets 200', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code, pm.response.text()).to.equal(200); });
pm.test('the client sees the final message and no dropped call', function () { pm.expect(types(pm.response.json().output)).to.eql(['message']); });
state(function (calls, tools) { pm.test('the injected tool ran once and the turn was re-asked once', function () { pm.expect(tools).to.equal(1); pm.expect(calls.length).to.equal(2); });
pm.test('the unanswered client custom call is not replayed', function () { pm.expect(types(calls[1].body.input)).to.not.include('custom_tool_call'); });

pm.test('the injected call and its output are replayed', function () { var t = types(calls[1].body.input); pm.expect(t).to.include('function_call'); pm.expect(t).to.include('function_call_output'); });
